record.one_liner: Gumroad provides a REST API supporting OAuth2 and bearer tokens for managing products and interacting with user accounts.

auth_methods.quote: Your access token is used in the request header of every request to the API and should be kept secret, like a password.

access_test.quote: First, sign in to your Gumroad account. Then, go to advanced settings . Here, you'll see a form to create a new application.

access_ship.quote: To create an application for general use, you'll need to build a Redirect URI handler to generate access tokens for each of your users.

api_breadth.quote: head back to our API documentation for a list of endpoints the API makes available
